topology: 1 node x4 H100, NVSHMEM star: PE 1..3 push a full slot to PE 0, PE 0 answers each with slot/8
golden: none — assertions only; the shape is derived from params, not from a recorded run
workload_note: `asym_patterns hub 4096 3`. Three buffers per PE of three different sizes: recv = npes*slot = 16384 ints (65536 B), src = slot = 4096 ints (16384 B), resp = slot/8 = 512 ints (2048 B). app_buffer_bytes names the largest, recv. Each spoke writes its own disjoint region of PE 0's recv (dst_off = mype*slot), which is what makes PE 0's object a single buffer written by three different GPUs in three bands — the first capture in the corpus whose object heatmap is not flat. Volume is deliberately asymmetric: a spoke sends 4096 elems/iter and receives 512, so anything that symmetrises an edge reports the answer flow 8x too large.
